title: As-you-type search sends one- and two-letter terms the trigram index cannot serve
notes: A trigram index needs three characters; shorter terms scan items. Promote when measured: server time for 1-, 2- and 3-letter terms on GET /Items?searchTerm= (what jellyfin-web's search page sends, docs/status.md) and on /Search/Hints, on a library the size of the dogfood's and on 10,000 items. If a viewer waits long enough to notice (the bound is set from the measurement, not from the request's 50 ms), plan a prefix index. Issue #228. Closed at the pivot: Covered by JS-204: search from the first letters.
